description: HEC-RAS 2D Dam Breach Dataset – Tanahu Hydropower Project (Worst-Case Scenario) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Bishnu Dutta Kandel. This dataset contains all necessary input files to run a worst-case dam breach simulation for the Tanahu Storage Hydropower Project using HEC-RAS 2D. It includes geometry files, inflow hydrographs, terrain data, land cover-based Manning’s n assignments, and mapping outputs (flood depth, velocity, arrival time). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3558520339 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
